detail: Meta-analysis of 13 BCG-vaccine trials (Colditz et al. 1994); one row per study with aggregate 2x2 counts, no replication within study.
Beat-the-Blues trial in wide form: repeated BDI measures (bdi.pre..bdi.8m) spread across columns, one row per patient, no grouping column in the loaded table.

Cross-sectional survey of women; the sampling clusters (60 villages/neighbourhoods) are absent from the table, R_region is a fixed 6-level geographic covariate, and the HSAUR3 chapter fits only fixed-effects simultaneous-inference models.
Embedded-figures test, one row per child; group (row/corner) is a fixed two-level treatment, no repeated measures or clustering.
Cross-sectional ranking of 2000 companies; country and category are descriptive factors, no documented clustered or repeated-measures model.
Aggregated binomial GLM cbind(cases,non.cases) ~ gender + GHQ score; gender and GHQ are fixed, no random grouping factor.
A 5x7 smoking-level by cancer-diagnosis contingency table (loaded as 5 rows of counts); no grouping factor or response column.
41 US cities, one row each; SO2 regressed on six climate/ecology covariates, no grouping factor.
49 US states, one row each; melanoma mortality on latitude/longitude/ocean, coordinates are not groups and there is no grouping factor.
Ten US states, one row each; seven continuous socio-demographic variables, no grouping factor and no single documented response.
Wide-form table of 22 US cities by four months of temperatures, one row per city, no grouping column (loaded as string columns).
25 adults, one row each; body fat regressed on age and gender, no grouping factor.
14 paramo islands, one row each; species-area regression, no grouping factor.
31 patients, one row each; Poisson number ~ tumorsize + time, tumorsize fixed, no random grouping.
53 observations, one row each; recovery time regressed on log-dose and blood pressure, no grouping factor.
24 seeding days, one row each; rainfall regression with fixed seeding and echomotion factors, no grouping factor.
4x4 crossed genotype factorial (litgen x motgen) on litter weight; fixed-effects two-way ANOVA, genotypes are treatments of interest, not grouping factors.
25 athletes, one row each; seven event results (multivariate/PCA), no grouping factor or single response.
40 households, one row each; four expenditure responses plus gender (multivariate), no grouping factor.
44 patients, one row each; survival time with censoring, metastasized fixed, no clustering column.
Winning time of the Olympic men's 1500m, one winner per year 1896-2004; a single series with no replication.
An 8x3 oral-lesion-site by region contingency table; no grouping factor or response column.
Wide-form repeated phosphate measures (t0..t5), one row per subject, no grouping column in the loaded table.
A 4x3 compressor-by-leg failure contingency table; no grouping factor or response column.
32 subjects, one row each; logistic ESR ~ fibrinogen + globulin, no random grouping factor.
20 FAP patients, one row each; Poisson number ~ treat + age, no random grouping factor.
22 FAP patients, one row each; number3m ~ treatment + age + baseline + gender, no random grouping factor.
Nine-oxide chemical composition of pottery specimens classified by kiln site; the documented analysis is MANOVA / cluster analysis by kiln, with no single documented response column.
113 students, one row each; estimated width ~ unit (feet/metres) two-group comparison, no grouping factor.
251 patients, one row each; age at onset ~ gender two-group comparison, no grouping factor.
Quine's absenteeism data; 154 children, one row each; race/gender/school/learner are fixed classification factors (school is form/grade), no random grouping.
Four Egyptian-skull measurements by epoch; one-way MANOVA over five epochs, no single documented response column.
Meta-analysis of 26 nicotine-gum trials (Silagy 2003); one row per study with aggregate binomial counts, no replication within study.
35 students, one row each; two parallel test scores (low/high) compared across three fixed treatments (multivariate mean test), no grouping factor.
Wide-form table of 15 countries by five age-group suicide rates, one row per country; rates not counts, no grouping column.
A 15x15 congressmen voting-dissimilarity matrix used for MDS; no grouping factor or response column.
61 towns, one row each; mortality ~ hardness regression, location a fixed two-level covariate and town a unique id, no grouping factor.
2x2 completely randomised factorial (source x type) on rat weight gain; fixed-effects two-way ANOVA, no blocking or grouping factor.
Aggregated binomial GLM cbind(agree,disagree) ~ education + gender; fixed effects, no random grouping factor.
